body:
## Finding

The #2039 design doc merged by PR #3807 points readers at a section §8 that does not exist in the document. Two references dangle:

- Status line: "implementation is phased in §8"
- Prerequisites note: "Do not present the existing host journal or the attestation PoC as that prerequisite (§2, §8)"

The document's numbered sections run §1–§7 under "Recommended protocol"; the phased implementation plan the references mean is the unnumbered `## Phased implementation plan` section near the end (the 8-phase table). §2 exists; §8 does not — a reader following the status line to find the phasing, or the prerequisite note to find why the PoC is not the prerequisite, lands nowhere.

## Evidence

- Source PR: #3807 `design(id): #2039 match attestation + audit v1`, commit `65eb6ccc5f2c65d78767cbc81359d5c04d5b6178`; merge `048a01d9b37730038e1d9fa6bd4f487dcde8bba3` (verified an ancestor of main by the compare API).
- Current main (verified 2026-11-08 via the contents API at ref=main, two reads): `doc/2026-11-01_design_id2039.md`
  - Line 4: "implementation is phased in §8"
  - Line 14: "…as that prerequisite (§2, §8)"
  - Headings: `### 1.`–`### 7.` at lines 43–102, then unnumbered `## Invariants` (:128), `## Acceptance criteria for implementation` (:140), `## Open decisions for Drew` (:154), `## Phased implementation plan` (:164), `## Non-goals` (:179). No §8 heading anywhere.
- The implementation split the design deferred ("Do not create implementation issues in this design change; split them after this design receives its review", :166) has since happened — #3792 is open from #2039 — so this is only the dangling-reference fix, not a request to split anything.

## Why it matters

This doc is the v1 protocol reference for match attestation/audit and is linked from #2039 and epic #2056; its status line is the entry point for anyone picking up a phase. A dangling §8 in the second line a reader sees undermines the doc's own source-precedence discipline (it corrects two investigation docs) and wastes every new reader's first lookup.

## Acceptance criteria

- Both §8 references resolve: either number the existing sections so the Phased implementation plan is §8, or retitle the references to name the "Phased implementation plan" section directly — one consistent choice applied to lines 4 and 14.
- A grep of the doc for `§` references shows every cited section exists in the document.
- No protocol content changes: wording, phases, gates, and open decisions are byte-identical apart from the reference/heading fix.
